[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation to excise the whole lesion with a 1–3 mm margin is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.",
  "The surgical margin size should be determined based on the thickness of the tumor."
]
